clauses.why: The verse says Shamed (one of Elpaal's sons) built Ono; 'Lod and its towns' is a detail about Lod, and the record's own fact is that it was built by Elpaal's son.
clauses.english: was built by Shamed, a son of Elpaal
clauses.deu: wurde von Semer, einem Sohn Elpaals, gebaut
clauses.spa: fue edificada por Semeb, hijo de Elphaal
